hook_lines: This Japan foot patch from Don Quijote

chalkboard.title: What People Are Saying
bullets: Adds wood vinegar (missing from Daiso's mugwort version) — absorbs sweat and visibly darkens
Adhesive + patch are one piece — no separate tape needed
The browning is a sweat reaction, not toxin removal — per Japanese verification blogs
Time to notice results varies a lot — 1 to 10 weeks
usage_steps: Apply directly to clean, dry feet
Stick it on before bed, leave it on until morning
Each sheet is single-use — swap in a new one next time
If the peeled-off sheet feels damp, rinse with lukewarm water

usage_placeholder.description: 실제로 밤에 발바닥에 시트를 붙이고 자고 일어나서 떼어보는 영상. 붙이는 손동작 + 다음날 아침 시트가 갈변한 모습을 보여주는 클로즈업. 10~15초.

quotes.japanese: ツルツルになって、ゴワゴワしていたのが柔らかくなります
quotes.translation: My skin got smooth, and the rough parts turned soft.

quotes.japanese: 1週間くらい、何かガサガサしてるので、やっぱり10週間ぐらい経ってから効果が出ました
quotes.translation: For about a week it still felt kind of rough, but the real effect only showed up after about ten weeks.

quotes.japanese: 簡単に履くケアができるのが魅力
quotes.translation: The appeal is that it's care you can do just by wearing it — nothing complicated.
